overview: This paper proposes an improved Adversarial Diffusion Compression (ADC) method to distill a heavy 3D DiT teacher into a compact '2D+1D' student network for Real-World Video Super-Resolution, utilizing a dual-head dual-discriminator scheme to disentangle and balance detail richness and temporal consistency.

modules.name: AdcVSR Generator Architecture
modules.description: Implements the student generator network, combining a pruned 2D Stable Diffusion UNet backbone with inserted 1D temporal residual blocks to form the '2D+1D' structure, along with a pruned VAE decoder for spatial decoding.

modules.name: Dual-Domain Dual-Head Discriminator
modules.description: Constructs the adversarial discriminators operating in pixel and feature domains, each built on a frozen pretrained backbone and tailing into two linear projection heads to separately evaluate spatial detail realism and temporal consistency.

modules.name: Video Degradation Synthesis Pipeline
modules.description: Simulates real-world degradations by applying random high-order processes including noise, blur, resizing, and compression to high-resolution videos to synthesize low-resolution inputs for training.

modules.name: Curated Discriminator Data Sampling
modules.description: Manages the sampling and labeling logic for the five curated data types (student outputs, real videos, shuffled videos, pseudo-static image videos, and random image sequences) to provide disentangled supervision signals for the detail and consistency heads.

modules.name: Distillation and Fidelity Losses
modules.description: Computes the regression losses between student and teacher outputs, including L1 distance and DISTS in the pixel domain, as well as L1 distance in the VAE decoder feature domain.

modules.name: Decoupled Adversarial Loss Logic
modules.description: Implements the non-saturating adversarial loss calculation for the generator and the dual-head discriminator loss based on the specific label mappings (Real/Fake/Unlabeled) for detail and consistency objectives.

modules.name: Stage 1: Knowledge Distillation Trainer
modules.description: Manages the first training stage, performing error-minimizing distillation from the frozen 3D DiT teacher to the AdcVSR student without adversarial learning to establish a baseline mapping.

modules.name: Stage 2: Adversarial Distillation Trainer
modules.description: Orchestrates the second training stage, fine-tuning the student and training the dual-head discriminators end-to-end using the combined distillation and decoupled adversarial losses to balance details and consistency.

modules.name: Temporal Consistency Evaluation
modules.description: Calculates the flow warping error metric using optical flow estimation between consecutive frames to quantitatively assess the temporal stability and consistency of the super-resolved videos.

modules.name: Perceptual and Fidelity Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Integrates evaluation scripts for full-reference fidelity metrics, full-reference perceptual metrics, and no-reference image quality assessment metrics across synthetic and real-world test datasets.

modules.name: Video Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Handles the end-to-end inference process, including input preprocessing, latent encoding, one-step denoising with the AdcVSR network, and decoding back to pixel space for video generation.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Management
modules.description: Manages YAML/JSON based configurations for architectural pruning ratios, loss weights, learning rate schedules, and the distinct training setups for the two-stage optimization process.
